candidates: In `packages/mermaid/src/docs/`, use relative `.md` file paths (e.g., `../config/icons.md`) for cross-references rather than `.html` URLs. The VitePress build pipeline automatically converts `.md` links to correct HTML URLs at build time. See `packages/mermaid/src/docs/config/usage.md` for examples of this convention.

Documentation for features shared across multiple diagram types (e.g., icon registration) belongs in `packages/mermaid/src/docs/config/` rather than inside a diagram-specific syntax file. Diagram syntax docs should link to the shared config page rather than embed or duplicate the content.

CDN and npm package URLs used in documentation code examples must pin a major version (e.g., `@iconify-json/logos@1` instead of `@iconify-json/logos`) to prevent future major releases from silently breaking the documented examples.

When adding a new entry to the VitePress sidebar in `packages/mermaid/src/docs/.vitepress/config.ts`, place it in the correct logical position within its section and do not insert it between logically adjacent entries that should remain contiguous.

Code examples in Mermaid documentation that reference icon names or image URLs must use assets that render correctly on mermaid.js.org. For icons, use packs already registered on the site (e.g., `logos:zod`); for images, prefer assets hosted at `mermaid.js.org` (e.g., `https://mermaid.js.org/favicon.svg`). Do not use placeholder URLs such as `https://example.com/...` that produce render errors.
